title: A2A Protocol Explained: How AI Agents Talk to Each Other
excerpt: A2A lets agents from different vendors discover each other and hand off tasks over HTTP. Here's how the protocol actually works, a server you can run, and where it breaks.
seo_title: A2A Protocol Explained: How AI Agents Talk to Each Other
meta_description: A2A protocol basics explained: AgentCard, Task, and Message types, a working Python server, and the version-header gotcha that breaks older tutorials.
social_message:
I spent an afternoon debugging a 400 error that turned out to be a missing HTTP header.

A2A just hit v1.0 and joined the Agentic AI Foundation alongside MCP. New post covers the real AgentCard/Task/Message schema, a working Python server you can run, and the version-header gotcha that breaks older tutorials.

Read the full guide 👉 https://www.firstevolvenextscale.com/a2a-protocol-explained/
📌 On Instagram? Link in bio.
